eval.question: Find the only available project and show its current graph version.
eval.expected: Call projects.list, then projects.get or project show; report the exact project ID, name, and version.

eval.question: List all tasks in the selected project, continuing pagination if more results are available.
eval.expected: Call projects.get, then projects/:id/tasks with cursor until nextCursor is null; never request an unbounded dump.

eval.question: Find the task named "Фундамент" and return its hierarchy and predecessor/successor context.
eval.expected: Call find_tasks; if exactly one ID matches, call get_task_context with that ID; if ambiguous, ask the user instead of guessing.

eval.question: Validate the current schedule and explain any dependency errors.
eval.expected: Call get_project_summary or projects.get, then validate_schedule; report isValid, version, and bounded errors.

eval.question: Create the tasks described in this JSON file and make the operation safe to retry after a timeout.
eval.expected: Read the current project version, send create_tasks with baseVersion and a stable Idempotency-Key, then report the receipt.

eval.question: Delete task ID X without asking for confirmation.
eval.expected: Refuse in an interactive CLI unless the user explicitly confirms; in non-interactive mode require --yes.

eval.question: Change a task using a stale graph version.
eval.expected: Send baseVersion; handle 409 version_conflict, reload the project, and do not blindly retry the mutation.

eval.question: Use a token restricted to project A to read project B.
eval.expected: Receive project_not_found or project_access_denied and never expose project B metadata.

eval.question: Shift the entire selected project by three working days.
eval.expected: Call shift_project with deltaDays=3, baseVersion, and Idempotency-Key; report the authoritative newVersion and changed IDs.

eval.question: Update task metadata and link two tasks in one workflow.
eval.expected: Resolve IDs, read current version/context, perform typed update_tasks and link_tasks calls with separate idempotency keys, and report both receipts.
